arcade-label.purpose: Bold Arial, at least 11 logical pixels, with a dark outline behind light text.

arcade-body.purpose: 16px Arial dialogue outside the canvas; 15px portrait, 14px short portrait, and 12px compact landscape.

arcade-data.purpose: 14px Arial data with tabular numerals; stronger 18–20px names and district labels.

shadows.name: shared-action
shadows.purpose: Hard physical edge beneath menu controls.

shadows.name: arcade-frame
shadows.purpose: Soft depth under the Level 6 bezel.

motion.name: menu-press
motion.purpose: Immediate pressed state; touch keys use 4px.

motion.name: arcade-screen-shake
motion.purpose: Brief horizontal combat shake, disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Shared action geometry; the secondary palette is scoped to Level 6.
components.css: .ds-button-primary {font-family:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; border:2px solid var(--outline, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)); cursor:pointer; min-width:132px; min-height:44px; padding:0 18px; background:var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62)); color:var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)); font-weight:800;} .ds-button-primary:hover {filter:brightness(1.08);} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); outline-offset:4px;} .ds-button-primary:active {transform:translateY(3px); box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255));}

components.name: Arcade secondary action
components.description: Shared action geometry; the secondary palette is scoped to Level 6.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary {font-family:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; border:2px solid var(--outline, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)); cursor:pointer; min-width:132px; min-height:44px; padding:0 18px; background:#293644; color:#ffe5b7; font-weight:800;} .ds-button-secondary:hover {filter:brightness(1.08);} .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); outline-offset:4px;} .ds-button-secondary:active {transform:translateY(3px); box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255));}

components.name: Selected level card
components.description: The level picker shows a number, title, and run status.
components.css: .ds-level-card {font-family:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; border:2px solid var(--outline, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)); cursor:pointer; display:grid; gap:3px; min-width:140px; min-height:44px; padding:clamp(6px,1.6vw,10px); text-align:left; background:var(--panel-2, oklch(23% 0.025 255)); color:var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); border-color:var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)),inset 0 0 0 2px var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62));} .ds-level-title {font-size:14px; line-height:1.1; color:var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62)); font-weight:800;} .ds-level-number,.ds-level-status {font-size:11px; opacity:.7;} .ds-level-card:hover {filter:brightness(1.08);} .ds-level-card:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Scoreboard name field
components.description: The existing score submission field preserves text selection and touch editing.
components.css: .ds-name-input {font-family:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; border:2px solid var(--outline, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)); cursor:pointer; min-height:44px; min-width:0; padding:0 12px; background:var(--panel, oklch(15% 0.02 255)); color:var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); font-size:clamp(11px,2.4vw,15px); letter-spacing:1px; text-align:center; user-select:text; touch-action:manipulation; cursor:text;} .ds-name-input::placeholder {color:var(--muted, oklch(70% 0.035 95)); opacity:.7;} .ds-name-input:focus {outline:none; border-color:var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)),inset 0 0 0 2px var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62));} .ds-name-input:disabled {opacity:.55; cursor:default;}

components.name: Leaderboard tab
components.description: Compact tabs reuse the selected orange stroke.
components.css: .ds-leaderboard-tab {font-family:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; border:2px solid var(--outline, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)); cursor:pointer; min-height:40px; padding:6px 14px; font-size:clamp(10px,2.2vw,14px); font-weight:800; background:var(--panel-2, oklch(23% 0.025 255)); color:var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); border-color:var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62)); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink, oklch(8% 0.01 255)),inset 0 0 0 2px var(--bitcoin, oklch(72% 0.18 62));} .ds-leaderboard-tab:hover {filter:brightness(1.08);} .ds-leaderboard-tab:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Special attack touch key
components.description: Mint special key in a two-by-two action grid, 60px normally, 52px short portrait, and 50px landscape. Its accessible label follows the selected fighter.
components.css: .ds-power {font-family:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; width:60px; height:60px; padding:0; display:grid; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:50%; background:#7af0be; color:#102b2a; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; line-height:1; text-shadow:none; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 oklch(38% 0.028 255 / .7),inset 0 -4px 0 oklch(6% 0.013 255); cursor:pointer; touch-action:none;} .ds-power:hover {filter:brightness(1.08);} .ds-power:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--paper, oklch(93% 0.018 80)); outline-offset:4px;} .ds-power:active {transform:translateY(4px); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 oklch(38% 0.028 255 / .7),inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(6% 0.013 255);}

narrative.overview: Five classic pixel levels and Level 6: four selectable fighters, eight districts, sixteen fights, and throwable street objects. Essential status and instructions use sharp HTML text around a 640×360 logical playfield rendered at 1280×720.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp pixels, dark outlines, readable silhouettes, and direct arcade labels.
Warm financial-district scenery behind a clear fighting lane.
Sharp status and instructions around a pixel playfield, with expressive characters and throwable street objects.
dos: **Do** preserve the first five levels and scope the arcade presentation to `body.brawler-mode` and the Level 6 renderer.
**Do** keep gameplay pixels crisp and the lower street clear enough to read movement and attacks.
**Do** retain the alternate-2026 satire label and distinguish imagined dialogue from real quotations.
donts: **Don't** apply the 16:9 viewport, arcade palette, or richer sprites to classic levels by default.
**Don't** treat “32-bit” as a required hardware emulation limit.
**Don't** claim an approved visual mockup; this system records the implemented game extension.
